title: Anthropic doubles Claude Code rate limits across paid plans
summary: At the Code with Claude developer conference, Anthropic announced an immediate doubling of Claude Code 5-hour rate limits across Pro, Max, Teams and Enterprise plans, and removed the peak-hour limit reduction for Pro and Max users. API limits for Opus models were also raised.

research.notes: Conference announcement reported in transcript. The reported SpaceX compute partnership and 'Colossus 1' framing is unverified and likely speculative.
